# StarRailAssistant Public API

Free, key-less public REST API serving current game version and in-game event data as JSON. Data is extracted from official game announcements and manually verified by the community. No signup or API key required.

## Base URL

```
https://starrailassistant.top/api/v1
```

## Endpoints

- `GET /activity/{game}.json` — activity data in the default locale (zh-CN), e.g. `/activity/sr.json`
- `GET /activity/{game}-{locale}.json` — activity data in a specific locale, e.g. `/activity/sr-en-US.json`

## Games

| id         | game                      |
| ---------- | ------------------------- |
| `sr`       | Honkai: Star Rail         |
| `ys`       | Genshin Impact            |
| `zzz`      | Zenless Zone Zero         |
| `ww`       | Wuthering Waves           |
| `nte`      | NTE                       |
| `ba-cn`    | Blue Archive (CN)         |
| `ba-jp`    | Blue Archive (JP)         |
| `ba-global`| Blue Archive (Global)     |
| `ak`       | Arknights                 |
| `end`      | Arknights: Endfield       |
| `xtlr`     | Stella Sora               |

## Response schema

```json
{
  "version": "4.4",
  "versionName": "version display name",
  "startTime": "ISO 8601",
  "endTime": "ISO 8601",
  "cover": "optional image URL",
  "activities": [
    {
      "name": "activity name",
      "kind": "optional category",
      "description": "activity description",
      "startTime": "ISO 8601",
      "endTime": "ISO 8601",
      "cover": "optional image URL"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Optional

- Docs (zh-CN): https://starrailassistant.top/reference/public-api/
- Docs (en-US): https://starrailassistant.top/en/reference/public-api/
